detail.longDescription: As a small business owner running multiple newsletters, I'm always hunting for ways to claw back a few hours. So my ears perked up when I first heard Lindy AI's pitch that it could save me time. Of course, I had questions: namely, how much does it actually cost to save me that time? I dug in, and here's what you need to know about Lindy's plans, credits, hidden costs, and how it stacks up against Zapier before you commit. Table of contents: What is Lindy? Lindy pricing overview Who is Lindy best
